6881112_d719dc7d.text: nearly all VMH neurons express two markers, steroidogenic factor 1 (SF-1 encoded by Nr5a1), and the vesicular glutamate transporter 2 (VGLUT2 encoded by Slc17a6). The prominent expression of Vglut2 in the VMH (Ziegler et al., 2002)(Fremeau et al., 2001) suggests that excitatory, glutamatergic neurotransmission mediates multiple and diverse aspects of VMH functions. In addition, glutamatergic connections between the VMH and other metabolic brain centers, such as the arcuate nucleus have been documented (Fu et al., 2008)(Sternson et al., 2005)

6881112_017e3b13.text: Nearly all VMH neurons, including those in the sexually dimorphic ventrolateral VMH (VMHvl) subregion, release the excitatory neurotransmitter glutamate and use the vesicular glutamate transporter 2 (Vglut2).
